verdict.rationale: Tavily is API-first. Every core capability has a documented API endpoint and SDK method: search, extract, crawl, map, and research, including research status retrieval and streaming. Dashboard-style data is also exposed through API endpoints for API key and usage details and per-request usage logs, and a CLI and MCP server mirror the core tools. Missing for 10: no explicit UI/API parity statement, no evidence that API key creation, billing or plan management, or project administration can be done via API, and no OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404).
